en: To be honest my main reason to go gym has been for aesthetic purposes.
zh: 说实话，我去健身房的主要原因一直都是为了身材好看。

en: like for a toned body even though research shows time and time the benefits of regular exercise on health,
zh: 比如想练出紧致的身体，尽管研究一次又一次地证明，规律运动对健康有很多好处，

en: especially as we age, to reduce that age-related decline and for longevity.
zh: 尤其是随着我们年龄增长，它能减缓和年龄相关的身体衰退，也有助于长寿。

en: Even though I knew that I still wasn't exercising for health reasons.
zh: 虽然我知道这些，但我之前还是没有因为健康原因去运动。

en: until I started working as a doctor and I got to meet patients from all ages with all kinds of backgrounds.
zh: 直到我开始当医生，接触到各个年龄段、各种背景的病人。

en: Like literally a couple of weeks ago.
zh: 就比如，真的就在几周前。

en: I was scheduled to see this 70 year old lady as my patient.
zh: 我被安排接诊一位70岁的女士。

en: It was the appointment time so I went to the waiting area
zh: 到了预约时间，所以我去了候诊区，

en: where patients sit and wait to be called out by their doctor.
zh: 也就是病人坐在那里等医生叫号的地方。

en: I went there and I can't see my patient.
zh: 我去了那里，却没看到我的病人。

en: There's no patient who's in their 70s or who's elderly in that waiting room.
zh: 候诊室里没有看起来70多岁的人，也没有看起来年纪很大的病人。

en: I go back to my computer.
zh: 于是我回到电脑前。

en: On the system I check the patient's name and date of birth
zh: 我在系统里核对了病人的姓名和出生日期，

en: and the system shows the patient is arrived.
zh: 系统显示这位病人已经到了。

en: So I go out in the waiting area again.
zh: 所以我又回到了候诊区。

en: Still there's only a few patients there and none of them are elderly.
zh: 那里还是只有几个病人，而且没有一个看起来年纪很大。

en: But I call out her name anyway.
zh: 但我还是叫了她的名字。

en: and then this 40 year old looking very healthy lady comes towards me.
zh: 然后一位看起来像40岁、非常健康的女士朝我走了过来。

en: I'm surprised so I ask her to confirm her name and date of birth again
zh: 我很惊讶，所以又让她确认了一遍姓名和出生日期，

en: and it's correct. And I ask her like what's your secret?
zh: 结果都对。然后我就问她，你到底有什么秘诀？

en: You literally don't look like you're in your 70s you look like you're in your 40s.
zh: 你真的完全不像70多岁的人，你看起来就像40多岁。

en: And obviously she was very flattered.
zh: 很显然，她听了特别开心。

en: She said her career requires her to be regularly active.
zh: 她说她的工作要求她经常保持活动。

en: She works as a cleaner, she loved her job.
zh: 她是一名清洁工，她很喜欢自己的工作。

en: she was active due to her job every day and that's not a one-off example that I've seen.
zh: 她因为工作每天都很活跃，而且这并不是我见过的唯一一个例子。

en: There is this specific group of 60 to 70 something year olds that I see who look very healthy for their age
zh: 我见过一类很特别的六七十岁的人，他们看起来比同龄人健康很多，

en: and one thing they have in common is how active they've been their whole life.
zh: 而他们有一个共同点，就是他们一辈子都保持着很高的活动量。

en: I actually ask every patient who I think look very young and healthy for their age.
zh: 其实每次我看到那些比实际年龄显得年轻又健康的病人，我都会去问。

en: I'm nosy like I'm actually interested in what makes them look so healthy so independent.
zh: 我就是有点爱打听，因为我真的很好奇，到底是什么让他们看起来这么健康、这么独立。

en: because I want to be able to climb mountains and like run off the hills
zh: 因为我希望自己70岁的时候，依然能爬山，还能那样从山坡上跑下来，

en: when I'm 70. If you want to be as well we should exercise for health reasons.
zh: 如果你也想这样，那我们就应该为了健康而运动。
